content: David, Nabal, degi, Abigail
Samuel burgwisad. Geb e-neggwebur-Ramáʼgi diglesad. Bela Israel-dulemar ega bomalaga nonimalad. A-sorbali, David, Parán-nega-dulesulidganse naded.

Maónʼgine dule-wargwen-mani-ibed maid. We-duledi, sibad-wawaad milipaa (3,000) nikad, degi, sibad miligwen (1,000) nikabalid. We-dule, Carmel-neggweburgi neg-dummad-nikadgi sibad-wawaadmar-e-absar enidaed.
We-dule, Nabalʼye nugad, Caleb-wagwad. E-ome, Abigailʼye nugad. We-omedi, yeerdakleged, deginbali, nue ibmar wisbalid. Nabalʼdi, dule-binged-satedid, degi, dule-isganabalid.
David nega-dulesulidgangi-gudiidgi wisgusad, Nabalʼde e-sibad-wawaadmar-e-absar eninaye.
Geb degine, David na e-sordagan ambe (10) barmisad, geb wemarga sogsad: “Carmel-neggweburse be namala, an-nuggine Nabalʼga be sogmalo, David be-obarye, bede nueganbi-gudii-sogeye sogye.
Nabalʼga be sogbalo: ‘¡Bitigi bede, be-gwenadgan, degi, bela be-neguyagi-gudimalad nueganbimarmogana gadinye!

An be-wisgusad, bede be-sibad-wawaadmar-e-absar eninaye. Na be wisguergebed, be-sibad-edarbemalad anmarba gudigusmargu, anmar ega akar-sogsasulid. Wegi Carmelʼgi na gudigusmargu, e-ibe anmar bipisaar ibmar sussulid.

Be-maimarse be egise, na emar bega sogoed. Degisoggu, an-sordagan bitigi be nued abindaksana gadin, ar anmar emi-ibagi iba onogergebed. An bese wileged, na be-maimarga, degi, anga, ar ibu be nika, a be uksunna.’ ”
David-e-sordagan mosmargua, ar igi David ega ibmar-sogsa, deyobi Nabalʼga ibmar sogdapmalad, geb abitobukwa gusmalad.
Ar Nabalʼdi, weyob abin-imaksad: —¿Ar Davidʼde, doa-dule? ¿Ar Isaí-machide, doasunna? Ar emi-iba, bukidar maimar na e-dummadgi wakindidamalad.
An-madu, an-dii, degi, ibmar-durgan-san, an-sibad-wawaad-e-absar-enimaladga an sabosad, ar an dulemar-akudakmaladga, ¿an ukode? Suli, an uked sate.
David-e-sordagan biir-imaksamalad, geb nadmalad. Davidʼse-mosmargua, ar igi Nabal ega ibmar-sogsa, deyobi bela Davidʼga sogsamalad.

Geb degine, David e-sordaganga igar ukded: “¡Es-suid be nasikmar!” Belagwable, Davidʼse-bakale, na es-suid dikargi nasiksamalad. Davidʼba dulataled-ilabake-mergue (400) sordagan nadmalad. Bamalad-sordagan-dulataled-ilabogwaddi (200) na ibmar-edarbega besmalad.

Mai-wargwendi, Nabal-ome-Abigail owisosad, weyob ega sogsad: —David, anmar-dummad-Nabalʼga nued-sogeye-sogega, nega-dulesulidgan-akale gayaburba-berbemalad barmialid. Ar degite, anmar-dummaddi nuedgi abin-daksasulid.
Mai sogdebalid: —We-dulemar nueganbi anmarbo gudigusmalad. Sapurba anmar eba gudigusmargu, bipisaale gwen anmarga akar-sogsasurmalad. Deginbali, anmar-ibe gwen ibmar sussurmarbalid.
Anmar wemar-walik sibad-wawaad-edarbedigusgu, ibginedba, mutikidba, wemar anmar-edarbismalad.
Degisoggu, Abigail, nue be binsao, ibu be imakoe. Ar anmar-dummad na e-berguedi, degi, e-neguyagi-bukmalad-berguedi na dukin bato igar mesisad. Ar Nabal dule-isganasoggu, dule geg ese goled.
Abigail gwae-gwae we-ibmarmar amisad:
A-sorbali, Abigail, e-maimarga sogded: “Be an-idu namala, an be-sorba naoed.” Ar e-sui-Nabalʼgardi gwen we-ibmar sogsasulid.
Abigail moli-uayasuid-birgi-sii yar-birgi-aidedanigu, David e-sordaganmala e-asabin-daniki dakalid. Degisoggu, na abingunonimarsunnad.
David sogsa gusanad: “An Nabalʼga nega-dulesulidgangi e-ibe mer ibmar-yogguega, an binsa ega ibmar edarbedii gusye. Emigindi, an ega ibmar-nued-imaksad-anale, edi aka isdar angi binsaed.
An neg-oiboged-iduar bela Nabal-e-neguyagi-bukmalad an ogilossulile, Bab-Dummad sabsur-an-odurdaksunno.”
Abigail, David-daksagua, moli-uayasuid-birgi-siidgi gwae aidesad. Geb David-abin wagar napase dulluu imaksad.
David-asabin sindigar-sii ega sogded: —Dummad, ani an nosad. An bega ibmar-sogbienad. Wis be an-itoge.

Dule-isgana-Nabalʼba mer be ibsae, ar e-nug-nugadba na deyob daed. E-nugdi sogleged, ‘dule-binsaedsulidye.’ Na binsaedsuli ibmar imakdaed. Dummad, ar andi be-gayaburba-berbemalad be barmiargusadi, an daksasulid.

”Ar Bab-Jehová, ablis-eogega be-imaksasulid. Degi, dukin-bugeb-mai-imakega, be-imaksasurbalid. ¡Napiragwa! Bab-Jehová-Dula-Maid-ular, degi, be dula-gudiid-ular, be-isdarmalad, degi, bela akar-be-imakbimalad, igi-Nabal-sabsur-odurdaklegoe, deyobi gumarmosunno.
Dummad, an we-ibmar binsa-bega-ukega-sedanikid be abingae, be-sordagan-beba-gudimaladbo be mimie.

An begi-nosadi, nossuliyob be an-dake. Napiragwa, Bab-Jehová bela be-wagan Israel-yargi reyga-megmalaga imakoed. Degine, dule-wargwensaale akar be-imakosulid, ar Bab-Jehová-e-bila-onogedgi be urwediid.
Ar amba dule be-oburgwega be-balegindiile, be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová be-bendakoed. Ar Bab-Jehová be-isdarmalad-oberguega dule dubgi-akwa-dikasur-metedaedyobi be-isdarmalad-metoed.

content.text: Degisoggu, Bab-Jehová bega bela ibmar-nuegan-imakoye-sogsad-imaksale, degine, Israel-dulemar-e-dummadga be-mesisbalile,
Degisoggu, be yogasaar buged-mai-imaksasulile, degi, be yogasaar ablis-eossurbalile, bar be binge-itogosulid.
Bab-Jehová bela bega ibmar-nasgumai-imaksale, be an-ebinsao.”

content: Geb degine, David Abigailʼga sogded: —¡Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-e-nug odummolesun! Ar an-abindakega be-barmialid.
Bedina, binsaed-nued-nikusadba Bab-Dummad begi nued binsasun. Ar ade, ablis-eogega be an-imaksasulid, degi, buged-mai-imakega be an-imaksasurbalid.
Ar Israel-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-dula-maidi, akar-be-imakega an-imaksasulid. Ar napira an bega soged, gwae be an-abin arsulina, banedse Nabal-e-sordagan wargwensaale dula-beosulinad.

David weyob sogsagu, ome-ega-ibmarmar-senonikidi, ome-abin susad. David omega sogdebalid: —Ar be anga ibmar-sogsad an be-itosad. Anse be ibmar-egichisadba an ibmar imakoed. Degisoggu, nuedgi be-negse be nae.
Abigail negse nonigua, daknonikid, Nabal reyyobi iba-dummad-ononai. Nabal weligwar itoged, degi, na bela-bela mummubalid. A-ulale, Abigail, banegidse geb ega ibmar sogsad.
Banegine, Nabal dadakusgua, geb e-ome ibmar-gusad ega sogsad. Ar Nabal weyob itosgua, e-gwage ega boo-nadednegoeded, geg bar nanae megisad.
Ibambe-gusad-sorbali (10), Bab-Jehová, Nabalʼga gannar boni daknonibalid. Geb deyobi, burgwissunnad.

David wisguargu Nabal burgwisye, sogded: “¡Bab-Jehová-e-nug odummolesun! Ar Nabal an-binge-imaksad-ulale, Bab-Jehová buged-mai anga Nabal-imaksad. Bab-Jehová mer-ibmar-isgana-imakega an-imaksad. Ar Nabalʼgi, na e-isgued, dukin-egi-aibinega imaksad.” Geb degine, David, Abigail-nikuega ese gayaburba barmisad.
David-maimar Carmelʼse mosmargua, Abigailʼbo sunmakdapmalad, ega sogdemalad: —David anmar-barmialid, bega sogega, ede be-nikubiye.
Abigail na wagar-napase-dulluu imaksad, geb sogded: —Ani an David e-maid. Andi ega ibmar-imakega guagwar gudiid. Deginbali, an e-maimarga e-nag-enuked guakwabalid.
Abigail weyob-sogsad-sorbali, naye sokarsunnad. Agine, moli-uayasuid-birgi nakwisad. Geb yagan-ega-arbamalad-walataledmala David-gayaburba-berbemaladba nadmalad. Geb Abigail, David-nikusad.
David, ome-Jezreelʼgined-Ahinoam nikusbalid. Degisoggu, we-omegan-ebogwad e-omega gunonikid.
Ar Saúlʼdi, na e-sisgwa-Mical-David-ome, Paltiʼye-nugadga uksad. Paltiʼdi, Galimʼginedid, Lais-e-machid.
